n48b2ada95d.headline: Saudi Arabia and Russia show confidence before OPEC meeting
n48b2ada95d.summary: Saudi Arabia and Russia expressed optimism about oil market prospects at a meeting of OPEC and non-OPEC countries.
n48b2ada95d.why: Saudi Arabia and Russia are key oil producers whose policies influence global oil supply and prices, affecting energy markets and inflation worldwide.
n48b2ada95d.why_moved: Positive signals from major producers ahead of OPEC meetings often lead to market expectations of supply management, supporting oil prices.
